release.notes: DEV TEST ONLY — Build 15.10.10: Refined Melody Channel panel to match KantaOke black-and-gold UI. Premium header and song label, highlighted AUTO detection, two-column CH 01-16 selector, used-channel/drums indicators, selected state, scrollable small-screen layout and TV D-pad focus. Existing per-song override, smart detection and level control are unchanged. Carries forward Build 15.10.9 Smart Melody v2, Build 15.10.8 disclaimer rotation fix and Stable 15.10.7 lyric look-ahead. No MIDI/lyrics/scoring/remote logic changes. Real-device QA needed; Stable/Beta untouched.
